content_sections.heading: About KSSSCI
content_sections.text: Kalyan Singh Super Specialty Cancer Institute (KSSSCI) is an autonomous institute of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. It is located at C.G. City, Sultanpur Road, Lucknow-226002. Its Executive Registrar Office issued this notification.

content_sections.heading: KSSSCI Senior Resident and Medical Physics Resident Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A Senior Resident (Hospital Services) starts on an initial pay of Rs. 67,700, and a Medical Physics Resident starts on Rs. 35,400. Pay and allowances follow the 7th Pay Commission under State Government or institute rules. The single Medical Physics Resident post is in the UR category. If no suitable EWS candidate applies, UR candidates will be considered for the EWS posts. The notice says the Resident positions are indicative only. They can increase or decrease at the time of the interview without notice, and will be filled as and when the services are started or expanded. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: KSSSCI Senior Resident and Medical Physics Resident Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years for both posts, counted as on the date of the interview. Candidates must be registered with the Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P. The prescribed qualification is only the minimum requirement, and having it does not guarantee selection. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates, government servants and other categories follows UP Government rules/DoPT rules. Reservation and age relaxation apply only to candidates with Uttar Pradesh domicile. OBC candidates must attach a self-attested copy of a caste certificate issued within the last 6 months. For the full eligibility of each post and discipline, check the official notification.

rows.qualification: M.Sc. in Medical Physics/M.Sc. in Physics from a recognized University followed by postgraduate Diploma in Radiological Physics from BARC, Mumbai or equivalent qualification recommended to AERB, Mumbai

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through the walk-in interview, and their original documents are checked at the same time. The selection committee's decision is final and binding, and no representations will be entertained. Results will be declared on the institute website ( https://cancerinstitute.edu.in ). Selected candidates will receive their appointment letter by email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 12 months. The contract expires automatically at the end of 12 months. It may be renewed at the absolute discretion of the Director, KSSSCI. No claim to a regular post: The appointment gives no right to a regular appointment, permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment. Termination: The institute can end the contract at any time without a notice period. An employee can leave by giving 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. Residents' services may also be ended without notice if bonded candidates from DGME join the institute. Work: This is a whole-time appointment, and private practice of every kind is prohibited. Appointees work in shifts and can be posted anywhere in the institute. Accommodation: Appointees must stay in campus accommodation if it is provided. Leave: Leave is governed by the institute's leave rules. Medical fitness: A certificate of medical fitness from a Medical Board designated by the institute is mandatory before joining. Travel allowance: No travelling or other allowance is paid for joining the post. Conduct: Taking part in any unlawful strike or agitation that is likely to affect patient care will lead to termination. Any form of canvassing disqualifies the candidate. Candidates must not have been convicted by any court of law. NOC: If an appointee is found to have hidden that they were in service without submitting a no-objection certificate, the appointment can be cancelled automatically at any stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSSSCI Senior Resident and Medical Physics Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form attached to the notification from the KSSSCI website. Pay the Rs. 500 fee by RTGS/NEFT to the institute account given above. Fill in the form legibly. Write the post applied for and the RTGS payment amount and date, and paste a self-signed passport-size photograph. If you are currently employed, have the head of your institution forward the application, or attach a No Objection Certificate. Attach self-attested photocopies of all the documents listed below. Report at the Admin. Block, KSSSCI, Lucknow by 09:30 AM on 2 November 2026 with the filled form and your original documents. Copy of the RTGS/NEFT payment, in original or as a computer printout ID proof (any one: PAN card, Passport, DL, Voter ID card, Aadhaar card) Address proof (any one: Passport, DL, Voter ID card, Aadhaar card) Matriculation certificate or another authentic age proof Three recent passport-size photos, facing the camera with the face fully visible Class 10th and 12th certificates MBBS/BDS/MHA mark sheet, degree and pass certificate, internship completion certificate, and MCI/DCI/State Medical Council registration proof Attempt certificate Certificate or proof that the MHA degree is recognised by MCI/DCI Evidence of work experience Reservation category certificate from the competent authority No Objection Certificate, if employed elsewhere Bring the originals of all these documents to the interview. Candidates who do not produce them will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the KSSSCI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 2 November 2026 at the Admin. Block of KSSSCI, C.G. City, Sultanpur Road, Lucknow. Reporting time is 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Can I join the interview if I arrive late?
faq.answer: Only until 11:00 AM. Candidates who report after 11:00 AM on the interview day will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident posts are there in each department?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in Surgical Oncology (1 OBC, 1 SC and 1 EWS) and 1 EWS post in Gynaecological Oncology.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Gynaecological Oncology Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: MD/DNB (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), along with registration with the Medical Council / Dental Council of U.P.

faq.question: Q5. What is the starting pay of a Medical Physics Resident?
faq.answer: The initial pay is Rs. 35,400 at Level-6 of the pay matrix (Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400).

faq.question: Q6. How do I pay the application fee?
faq.answer: Pay Rs. 500 by RTGS/NEFT to account number 37868945001 ("Director, SSCI&H, Academic Account") at State Bank of India, SGPGIMS branch, IFSC SBIN0007789. Then enclose the receipt with your form.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh get reservation benefits?
faq.answer: No. Reservation and age relaxation are given only to candidates with Uttar Pradesh domicile.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The contract is for 12 months and ends automatically after that. Renewal is at the absolute discretion of the Director, KSSSCI.

faq.question: Q9. How will I know if I am selected?
faq.answer: Results will be published on https://cancerinstitute.edu.in. The appointment letter is sent to selected candidates by email.

faq.question: Q10. What should employed candidates bring?
faq.answer: A No Objection Certificate from the competent authority of their current organisation, or an application forwarded by the head of their institution.
